posts.title: DBpedia – GSoC Bonding Period 2026
posts.summary: "Great job! You have been chosen as one of our GSoC contributor for the summer of 2026" — welcoming new contributors to connect with the community and mentors.

posts.title: News: Hindi DBpedia Chapter
posts.summary: Announcement of the Hindi DBpedia Chapter expansion, led by Dr. Sanju Tiwari at https://hi.dbpedia.org/, building multilingual knowledge graphs from Hindi Wikipedia using semantic web and NLP techniques.

posts.title: Recap: GSoC 2025 Summit
posts.summary: Account of the GSoC Mentor Summit in Munich (Oct 22-25, 2025) with 133 organizations participating. Sanju Tiwari reflects on involvement as DAAD Postdoc and GSoC mentor since 2022.
posts.author: Sanju Tiwari

posts.title: My DBpedia Internship Journey
posts.summary: Haniya Konain describes a four-month internship experience improving data quality in the DBpedia extraction framework, following GSoC completion.
posts.author: Haniya Konain

posts.title: Retrospective: Google Summer of Code 2025
posts.summary: DBpedia received 30 project proposals and supported developers for the 14th year in a row, with five finalists working on knowledge graphs, machine learning, and multilingual initiatives.

posts.title: Recap: DBpedia Day in Vienna @ SEMANTiCS 2025
posts.summary: Up to 100 DBpedians attended the September 3rd community gathering in Vienna, Austria featuring keynotes and sessions on semantic web technologies.

posts.title: CfP: KG operated by AI – DBpedia Day 2025
posts.summary: Call for presentations on intersections of large language models and knowledge graphs for DBpedia Day 2025. Submission deadline July 29.

posts.title: Recap 2024: A Year with DBpedia
posts.summary: Annual retrospective covering 17 years of DBpedia development, training sessions, and community events throughout 2024.

posts.title: Retrospective: Google Summer of Code 2024
posts.summary: DBpedia received 22 project proposals with six selected contributors working on extraction and knowledge graph projects in GSoC 2024.

posts.title: Recap: DBpedia Day in Amsterdam @ SEMANTiCS 2024
posts.summary: Community event in Amsterdam featuring approximately 100 participants discussing AI applications and knowledge graph construction at SEMANTiCS 2024.
